summary.intent: Clean up a set of open PRs after a batch of merges: fix the failing PR (#281), restack the non-stacked PRs (#281, #286 schemars, and the Rust edition migration branch) into one linear stack.
summary.outcome: Rebased #281 onto new main and fixed its failing tests, restacked #286 on #281, regenerated the edition branch on top of #286 with the migration redone, passed full local CI (exit=0), then committed and pushed it to be linked as a native stack.

repo: PR #274 added tests after #281's conversion that used bare package specs, so rebasing #281 onto main broke them; the specs had to be qualified (two pre-mode specs and a cascade test spec).
The repo has a pre-commit hook that rejects unformatted code, so run the formatter before committing.
Full local CI is run as a background command whose log ends with an `exit=N` line, which was used to confirm success before pushing.

The Rust edition migration required replacing unsafe env mutation (edition 2024 makes env::set_var/remove_var unsafe) and applying clippy let-chain fixes across many crates (callisto-graph, callisto-manifests, callisto-model, callisto-cli).
The edition branch was regenerated by resetting onto the schemars branch and redoing the migration steps, rather than rebasing it, which avoids conflicts from a mechanical, wide-reaching change.

code.finding: Cascade test spec used a bare package spec and had to be qualified after rebasing onto main with #274's tests.

workflow: Stack dependent PRs by rebasing each onto the previous PR's branch, then push and link them as a native stack.
For mechanical, repo-wide migrations, reset the branch onto the new base and redo the steps instead of resolving conflicts.
Wait for long-running CI via a background command and Monitor, and verify the exit line in the log before committing and pushing.
The command guard rejects some compound shell commands, so split them into separate Bash calls.

friction: Merging several PRs left some unstacked and at least one failing (#281) due to semantic conflicts with tests added in #274.
The pre-commit hook rejected the first commit for formatting, requiring a format and recommit.
The command guard rejected combined commands, so clippy fixes, format/lint, and CI had to be split up.
Repeated ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree switching was needed to work on each branch.
open_items: Link the three PRs (#281, #286, edition migration) as a native stack after the push, as stated in the plan.
Confirm remote CI passes on the restacked #281, #286, and edition PRs.
